pr_body:
<!-- Hey there. Thank you so much for improving NewPipe, and filling out the details. Having roughly the same layout helps everyone considerably :)-->

#### What is it?
- [x] Bugfix (user facing)
- [ ] Feature (user facing)
- [x] Codebase improvement (dev facing)
- [ ] Meta improvement to the project (dev facing)

#### Description of the changes in your PR
This PR replaces the outdated [Android-Universal-Image-Loader](https://github.com/nostra13/Android-Universal-Image-Loader) (which has not had any new release in the last 6 years) with the more stable and updated [Picasso](https://github.com/square/picasso). This hopefully fixes a [nasty unfixed issue](https://github.com/nostra13/Android-Universal-Image-Loader/issues/908) in Android-Universal-Image-Loader that was causing #4638. Also, the loading seems smoother to me, and retrieving images from memory cache is now instant, instead of taking a couple of milliseconds (try scrolling fast up and down after all thumbnails have been loaded).
I also added a switch in the *debug* settings to enable [indicators](https://square.github.io/picasso/static/debug.png).

#### Fixes the following issue(s)
Fixes #4638

#### APK testing 
@gulachev @k3a @Sekitan @UserX404 @nonremittal @arielshulman @dboydor @pauseee @astatine (taken from #4638)
Could you test [this APK from the CI](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/suites/2358978908/artifacts/49936658) and see if it fixes the issue? Thank you ;-)

#### Due diligence
- [x] I read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/blob/HEAD/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md).

Hey @Stypox, thanks for your work 🙏
Just ran a first try with known videos which crashed the phone and unfortunetly the error still occurs. 
How can I help?
Oh no... why does it still crash? Maybe the bitmap downloaded from the website itself is broken? Could you provide me the video url?
[This video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MCIaj-oLi28) is one of the rebellious videos.

Mmmh, this is really strange. I tried copying the thumbnail and returning the copy and I got this strange error... What does it mean?!?
```
W/e.debug.picass: Core platform API violation: Ljava/nio/Buffer;->address:J from Landroid/graphics/Bitmap; using JNI

    Core platform API violation: Ljava/nio/NIOAccess;->getBaseArray(Ljava/nio/Buffer;)Ljava/lang/Object; from Landroid/graphics/Bitmap; using JNI
```

@arielshulman could you test this APK? I implemented what you did in the issue, i.e. resizing to `width - 1` to force the creation of a new thumbnail. For some reason calling `.copy()` would cause the attached completion listeners to not be called and the error above to appear... What's wrong with these Bitmaps?!?
[app-debug.zip](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/files/6218052/app-debug.zip)

Why did you implement error handling for the video thumbnail, but not for the channel avatars or anywhere else?

Because you don't want to see a snackbar error for each image that can't be loaded, so the placeholder is shown instead in that case. The only place where I thought it would be useful to see an additional snackbar was the video thumbnail in `VideoDetailFragment`, since that's only one single image. Imagine a scenario where the extractor returns invalid urls for all stream info items: a snackbar for each one of them would not help, but only compromise app usage. Even without a snackbar the user notices that there is an issue, by just seeing that all thumbnails are replaced with the placeholder one.
